intro: Adjutant Tesoran has found Lieutenant Paval Reethe in the guard's records. They tell of an enlistment in the Kul Tiras marines at sixteen, distinguished service with promotions, and a place in the Theramore guard among the recruits who sailed over with Lady Proudmoore. The last entry lists Reethe as missing, and Captain Garran Vimes is to hear of it.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Reddon... Redpath... Ah, here it is! Lieutenant Paval Reethe.

Joined the Theramore guard along with most of the recruits that came across the sea with Lady Proudmoore. Enlisted with the marines of Kul Tiras at the age of sixteen. Distinguished service, promotions...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Missing? That would be Tesoran's kind way of saying traitor.
No doubt he's one of those fools so blindly loyal to Admiral Daelin that he turned traitor. Isn't that a delicious irony? The deserters accuse us of betraying the Alliance.
